Togo vs Algeria AFCON 2027 Qualifiers LIVE Streaming info — When, where to watch TOG v ALG?
 AFCON 2027 Qualifiers — Read the live streaming and telecast details of the Group I Matchday 4 fixture between Togo and Algeria, scheduled on November 17, 2026.

 Matchday 4 of the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations Qualifiers will see Togo host Group I leader Algeria at the Stade de Kégué in Lomé on Tuesday.
 Algeria sits at the top of Group I with seven points from three matches. The Desert Foxes edged Togo 1-0 in Tizi Ouzou on November 14 thanks to a second-half winner from Ramy Bensebaini. Having previously beaten Zambia 3-1 and drawn 2-2 away to Burundi, Brahim Hemdani’s side can virtually secure its spot at the 2027 continental tournament with another victory on Tuesday.
 Togo occupies third place in Group I with three points, having opened its campaign with a 1-0 home win over Burundi before suffering defeats to Zambia and Algeria. The Sparrowhawks will look to lean on home advantage in Lomé to avenge Saturday’s narrow loss and keep their qualification hopes on track.
 When and where will the Togo vs Algeria AFCON 2027 Qualifier be played? 
 The Togo vs Algeria 2027 Africa Cup of Nations Qualifier will be played at the Stade de Kégué in Lomé, Togo on November 17, 2026. The match will kick off at 4:00 pm local time (GMT) / 9:30 pm IST / 11:00 am ET.
 How to watch the Togo vs Algeria AFCON 2027 Qualifier? 
 The Togo vs Algeria 2027 Africa Cup of Nations Qualifier can be watched live on beIN SPORTS 2 in the Middle East and North Africa, on ENTV (Programme National / TV6) in Algeria, and on beIN SPORTS CONNECT, Fubo, and Tubi in the United States.
